title: Witness and Autopsy
author: M. M. Voss
blurb: Vesper Vasquez, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
